verdict.rationale: incident.io documents an official remote MCP server that lets an AI assistant query incidents, analyze alerts and manage escalations without opening the dashboard. It also documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI spec, so an agent can clearly handle the escalation part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent can acknowledge alerts/pages and resolve incidents via API or MCP, evidence that the full acknowledge→escalate→resolve lifecycle runs end to end with no dashboard step, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can acknowledge, escalate, and resolve incidents end to end through a documented API or MCP connection — no dashboard in the loop

citations.quote: Query incidents, analyze alerts, check who's on call, manage escalations, and run deep operational analysis — all from your existing AI tools.
